title: Spring Awakening is one of the all time greatest musical theater scor...
transcript: I just got this package from Spring Awakening in honor of their 20th anniversary and we're gonna open it together so Spring Awakening is one of my all time favorite musicals now I never got to see the original production on Broadway but I did get to see the Deaf West production which changed my life all that to say I'm very excited for this so let's open it there's a note from Steven about Duncan Sheik I can't say how much the release of this vinyl means to me or how much it meant to Duncan thank you all for all these years of listening Steven we also have this gorgeous Spring Awakening vinyl felt cover and then of course the vinyl itself and I didn't realize this is the first time it's been on vinyl which is kind of crazy so let's open it up look at that it's so beautiful and I don't know if you could tell on video but this logo has like a matte finish and has a really cool texture to it which I really like look at that Jonathan and Leah on the inside cover then we have the record itself whoa look at that it's mostly black and then I don't know if you can see there's like this one red streak then we have disc two this one is definitely more red you can see that Red Streak is much more pronounced there you also have like a ring of red uh around the center there I don't know if the camera does it justice but it's really stunning in person and then obviously we need to listen to these demo recordings so let's pop it on
